functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support capturing and validating all required personal details (name, gender, password, mobile number, location) for account creation with 100% field coverage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures all specified personal information can be fully entered during account registration process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication during account creation, requiring email or SMS verification of the mobile number provided.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Verifies the legitimacy of the user and protects against fraudulent account creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt all personal details using AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit, with no plain-text storage of sensitive information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user's personal information from unauthorized access or data breaches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement real-time validation with clear, specific error messages for each input field (e.g., password strength requirements, valid mobile number format).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users through account creation process and prevents incorrect data entry.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.9% uptime for the account creation service, with automatic failover and retry mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can create accounts consistently without service interruptions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete the entire account creation process in less than 2 minutes, with individual field validations occurring in under 500 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a quick and responsive account registration experience.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: Support import and management of at least 10 standard file formats for images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF), videos (MP4, AVI, MOV), and audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive support for various media file types in presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Process and load media files within 3 seconds for files up to 100 MB in size, with a maximum of 1-second preview generation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides responsive file handling and quick media preview capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: Limit memory consumption to 500 MB for processing and rendering multiple media files simultaneously.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient system resource management during media file handling.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Provide a drag-and-drop interface for file import with clear visual feedback on upload status and progress.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies the process of importing and managing media files in presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Ensure compatibility with major presentation software (Microsoft PowerPoint, Google Slides, Apple Keynote) for imported media files.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows seamless use of imported media across different presentation platforms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: Implement automatic file format conversion and error recovery for corrupted or incompatible media files.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides resilience against potential file import issues and format limitations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Perform virus and malware scanning on all imported media files before allowing them into the presentation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects the system and user from potential security threats through file imports.
